<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,827)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,4)>That Pokémon LOVES coral, so I usually saw them in places
with lotsa different kinds of coral.
<$voicel(2,8)>Maybe try looking for ’em over that way!

<$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,838)><$comeff(2,21)><$voicel(2,9)>Oooh, you met <$cdef(27)><$cname(567)>? YAY! If they need anything, make
sure to help ’em out!

<$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,838)><$comeff(2,13)><$voicel(2,10)>Aw, you helped <$cdef(27)><$cname(567)> out with their request? Thanks!
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,655)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>If they’ve got any other problems, please help ’em out!
